To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Anita Rao <anita@techforge.com>, Marco Silvestri <marco@cloudbridge.io>

Subject: ISV rollout gating and exemption logistics for CloudBridge listing

Team + Anita/Marco —

Quick sync note to align on technical gating, exemption path, and timeline for CloudBridge’s marketplace listing. We have two concurrent asks from the marketplace team: (1) a hard compatibility gate for the entitlement check (staging only) and (2) an exception path for customers using CloudBridge’s legacy connector. We need to decide owners, SLOs, and whether this qualifies for a temporary marketplace exemption.

Top-level asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm the minimal runtime changes required to surface the entitlement flag (approx dev days)?
- Ben: commerce/partner ops — what contract/entitlement work is needed to support exempted customers?
- Camila: product — do we need a UX change for customers who opt into the legacy connector path?
- Anita/Marco (CloudBridge/TechForge): confirm technical constraints and a target pilot list (5 customers).

Attached is the integration_spec_v2.pdf with the current gating matrix and an early SOW draft (sow_draft.docx). I want to lock an internal decision by COB Wed 9/15 so CloudBridge can target the marketplace prelist next week. If we need to escalate to legal for an exception covenant, flag now.

Thanks — short bullets and owners will help.

—
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ISV rollout gating and exemption logistics for CloudBridge listing

Lauren —

Thanks, this is clear. Quick technical read:
- Entitlement flag: straightforward; we can add a boolean in the serving proxy and expose via the catalog lookup. Estimated effort: 3 dev days + 1 QA day (total ~4 days) to ship a gated build to staging.
- Legacy connector exemption: this is messy because of KV cache formats and tokenization differences. To avoid regressions we need a compatibility shim + extra e2e tests. Rough estimate: 7 dev days + 2 infra days to add canary routing and observe divergence.

Proposed owners and timeline:
- Karthik (eng): implement flag + canary routing (ETA staging build by Thu 9/17)
- Ben (partner ops): draft exemption terms and pilot customer list (Ben, can you take?)
- Camila (product): UX fallback for legacy users + acceptance criteria

Dependency matrix (high level):
- Serving runtime change -> infra rollout -> catalog flag -> marketplace prelist
- If runtime change is delayed, we fallback to software-only shim but that increases risk of perf regressions

I attached a short excerpt from integration_spec_v2.pdf with a proposed rollback plan (see page 4) — main ask is decision on whether legal needs to sign off on a temporary exemption covenant or whether partner ops can approve for pilot customers.

Karthik
Sr. Engineering Manager, Integrations
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. From CloudBridge/TechForge side:
- Pilot customers: we can pull 4-6 customers who are on the legacy connector; they’re low-volume and agreeable to a canary pilot.
- Timeline: the pilot needs the staging flag and canary routing by next Thursday (9/24) to meet our marketplace window. If Redwood can deliver the staging build by 9/17 as Karthik suggested, we can run a 1-week pilot and provide feedback.
- Constraints: we cannot modify the legacy connector binaries in customer environments; the shim must be server-side only.

We’re fine with a limited exemption for pilot customers but will need explicit documentation of the failure modes and rollback steps so our ops team can intervene. I reviewed the SOW draft — a few small wording requests (liability/rollback SLA) that I’ll redline and return.

Appreciate the help; we’re flexible on supporting the pilot with our engineers during the week of 9/20 if that helps accelerate testing.

—
Anita Rao
Head of Platform Integrations, TechForge (CloudBridge partner)
anita@techforge.com

All —

Short status and decisions after internal sync:
- Decision: proceed with staged approach. Karthik’s team will ship the entitlement flag to staging (target 9/17). We’ll run a pilot with 4 customers from CloudBridge the week of 9/20.
- Exception path: partner ops will approve a time-limited marketplace exemption for pilot customers only. Legal will be looped for a short covenant if the pilot extends beyond 30 days.
- Owners:
  - Tech delivery (serving runtime & shim): Karthik (deliver 9/17 staging)
  - Partner ops & commercial terms: Ben (I’ll prep T&Cs and a limited exemption appendix by EOD Thu 9/16)
  - Product UX & acceptance: Camila (please confirm acceptance criteria by Thu 9/16)
  - Partner technical support: Anita/Marco (provide pilot customer list by Fri 9/17)

Actions immediate:
1) Ben to upload updated SOW and exemption appendix to the HubSpot deal (DBL-4821) and share the DocuSign link.
2) Karthik to post build notes and rollback plan to the integration doc (link below).
3) Camila to provide the UX acceptance checklist.

If anything blocks these items by EOD Thu 9/16, we escalate to Lauren for a decision and to Product/Legal to sign a limited covenant.

Thanks — I’ll circulate the DocuSign link as soon as the SOW is updated.
